app: A synthetic task board with create task, edit task, status change, and status filtering. The board has a Reset demo button and three seeded tasks: Draft release notes (To do), Review onboarding flow (In progress), and Approve color palette (Done).
resetGoal: Click Reset demo to restore the three seed tasks before recording.
feature: Status filtering. Show the Done filter includes Done tasks and excludes To do and In progress tasks, then show a second filter with a different matching set.
